name: Pohang Global AI Data Center (Pohang Neo AI Data Center, NeoAI Cloud)
notes: Phase 1 40MW (~2T KRW total; 5,500억 KRW phase 1) at Gwangmyeong General Industrial Complex, Ocheon-eup, Nam-gu. Building permit & land contract Jan 2026; groundbreaking around Jul 20 2026; commercial operation target Oct 2027; planned phased expansion to 260MW. Power from adjacent 345kV Sin-Pohang substation (>200MW supply possible).

name: Pohang Blue Valley Global Data Center Campus (subsea-cable-linked DC)
developer: SK Ecoplant, DCT Telecom, KB Asset Management
notes: MOU signed Sep 8 2023 by 8 organizations (MOTIE, Gyeongbuk province, Pohang city, KEPCO, KICOX, SK Ecoplant, DCT Telecom, KB Asset Mgmt). ~1.5T KRW investment; 4 x 30MW DC buildings, total 120MW targeted by 2027; includes Korea's first international subsea cable landing station (육양국). Later reports describe '조성 시동' (project start).

name: SK Mega AI Data Center (~80T KRW / 1.6GW) - Pohang Blue Valley candidate
notes: SK Telecom announced additional 1GW+ AIDC in Yeongnam region beyond Ulsan; site inspection at Pohang Blue Valley National Industrial Complex Jul 3 2026. Gyeongbuk Governor Lee Cheol-woo confirmed on SNS (Jul 5 2026) that SK is reviewing ~80T KRW / 1.6GW investment with Pohang Blue Valley the best-prepared candidate. Investment still under review, not final.

name: Penta City AI Data Center (120MW)
developer: Undisclosed global infrastructure asset manager (A) + Asia-Pacific datacenter platform (D)
notes: ~6T KRW phase-1 investment for 120MW AI DC by Dec 2028 at Penta City (Pohang Convergence Technology Industrial District), Heunghae-eup, Buk-gu foreign-investment zone (~47,603 m2). Site confirmed after Apr 2026 inspection; grid impact assessment applied to KEPCO; formal MOU with Gyeongbuk province & Pohang city scheduled Jul 22 2026; second 120MW phase planned. Company names anonymized in source.

name: KT Cloud AI Cloud Data Center (AI CDC, Gyeongbuk-type cloud DC)
notes: 10MW, ~1,100억 KRW; Korea's first public-private (민·관) cooperation cloud datacenter, located in the Gyeongbuk Provincial Office new city area, Yecheon-gun. Completion ceremony May 29 2025; in full operation providing public/private cloud and AI services.

name: Yeongcheon AI Data Center attraction (Daegu University idle land)
notes: MOU between Yeongcheon-si and Daegu University (Mar 30 2026) to efficiently utilize Daegu University's idle campus land and attract an AI datacenter. Early-stage initiative; no developer or scale announced yet.
